criterion: FX paper simulation is permitted only for explicitly legal/authorized instrument and venue specifications; unknown venue or jurisdiction becomes NO_TRADE.
test_result: 27 passed; Ruff passed; targeted mypy passed; source inventory check passed (616 Python files).
evidence_scope: Synthetic contract, venue authorization, exposure and quote fixtures. Paper-only conservative top-of-book simulation; no real exchange fill, execution cost schedule or profitability claim.
operational_limits: The RBI rule snapshot must be reviewed and updated if the Master Direction changes.
Dated source-hashed venue authorization and exposure records must be supplied by an authorized owner/provider; the engine does not fetch or authenticate the underlying documents.
The module returns a per-intent simulated quote fill and does not yet maintain an FX position book, funding ledger or broker connection.
Only the reviewed Indian exchange-traded currency products and venues are supported; other jurisdictions fail closed.
